mapper.select: SELECT `image_data` FROM `cors`.`item_review_images` WHERE `review_id` = #{reviewId} ORDER BY `id` ASC
SELECT ri.`image_data` FROM `cors`.`item_review_images` AS ri INNER JOIN `cors`.`item_reviews` AS ir ON ri.`review_id` = ir.`id` WHERE ir.`item_id` = #{itemId} ORDER BY ri.`id` DESC

SELECT ir.`id` AS `id`, ir.`item_id` AS `itemId`, ir.`shop_id` AS `shopId`, ir.`user_email` AS `userEmail`, ir.`reservation_id` AS `reservationId`, ir.`content` AS `content`, ir.`rating` AS `rating`, ir.`useful_count` AS `usefulCount`, ir.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, ir.`updated_at` AS `updatedAt`, /* 일반 구매와 예약 구매 중 존재하는 날짜를 orderDate로 채택 */ COALESCE(o.`created_at`, res.`created_at`) AS `orderDate` FROM `cors`.`item_reviews` AS ir /* 1. 일반 구매 내역 조인 */ LEFT JOIN `cors`.`order_items` AS oi ON ir.`reservation_id` = oi.`id` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`orders` AS o ON oi.`order_id` = o.`id` /* 2. 예약 내역 조인 (추가된 부분) */ LEFT JOIN `cors`.`reservation_items` AS ri ON ir.`reservation_id` = ri.`id` LEFT JOIN `cors`.`reservations` AS res ON ri.`reservation_id` = res.`id` WHERE ir.`id` = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL((SELECT `review_id` FROM `cors`.`item_review_likes` WHERE `review_id` = #{reviewId} AND `user_email` = #{email} LIMIT 1), 0)

SELECT c.`id` AS `id`, c.`review_id` AS `reviewId`, c.`user_email` AS `userEmail`, u.`name` AS `userName`, c.`content` AS `content`, c.`parent_id` AS `parentId`, c.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, c.`updated_at` AS `updatedAt` FROM `cors`.`item_review_comments` AS c LEFT JOIN `cors`.`users` AS u ON c.`user_email` = u.`email` WHERE c.`review_id` = #{reviewId} ORDER BY IFNULL(c.`parent_id`, c.`id`) ASC, c.`created_at` ASC

SELECT c.`id` AS `id`, c.`review_id` AS `reviewId`, c.`user_email` AS `userEmail`, u.`name` AS `userName`, c.`content` AS `content`, c.`parent_id` AS `parentId`, c.`created_at` AS `createdAt`, c.`updated_at` AS `updatedAt` FROM `cors`.`item_review_comments` AS c LEFT JOIN `cors`.`users` AS u ON c.`user_email` = u.`email` WHERE c.`id` = #{id} LIMIT 1
